# Eniolajun Global Integrated Services Ltd

> Eniolajun Global Integrated Services Ltd is a Nigerian real estate and total facility management company headquartered in Port Harcourt, Rivers State, operating across Port Harcourt, Lagos, Abuja, and nationwide. We specialize in residential estate governance, property administration, property sales, property valuation coordination, commercial facility operations, preventative building maintenance, and utility management.

## Core Services (10 Disciplines)
1. **Estate Management** (`/services#estate-management`): Comprehensive administration for residential estates and gated communities—bylaws administration, transparent service charge accounting, perimeter security, and common area maintenance.
2. **Property Management and Administration** (`/services#property-management`): End-to-end landlord and tenant management—tenant screening, tenancy agreement coordination with legal practitioners, rent collection administration, and routine condition audits.
3. **Property Sales** (`/services#property-sales`): Strategic marketing, acquisition support, title due diligence coordinated with legal/land registry partners, and closing documentation for residential and commercial real estate.
4. **Property Valuation and Consultancy** (`/services#property-valuation`): Market-grounded real estate consultancy, feasibility studies, rental yield analysis, and statutory/mortgage valuation coordination with accredited Estate Surveyors and Valuers.
5. **Facility Management** (`/services#facility-management`): Integrated Total Facilities Management (TFM), HSE compliance, SLA vendor oversight, space planning, and asset lifecycle tracking.
6. **Building Maintenance and Repairs** (`/services#building-maintenance`): Planned Preventative Maintenance (PPM) and on-call emergency repairs for electrical, plumbing, roofing, masonry, and carpentry systems.
7. **Estate Grounds and Landscaping Maintenance** (`/services#grounds-and-landscaping`): Horticultural care, lawn turf management, drainage de-silting, irrigation maintenance, and exterior pest control.
8. **Property Inspection and Refurbishment** (`/services#property-inspection-refurbishment`): Pre-purchase and pre-lease structural snagging audits, dampness diagnosis, and turnkey interior/exterior architectural renovations.
9. **Facility Installations and Coordination** (`/services#facility-installations-coordination`): Specification, procurement, installation, and commissioning of commercial generators, solar inverters, CCTV/biometrics, water filtration, and fire systems with accredited OEM/engineering specialists.
10. **Utilities and Facilities Operations Management** (`/services#utilities-operations-management`): Continuous management of central power distribution, diesel fuel quality auditing, borehole water treatment, waste logistics, and energy sub-metering.
